dimensions.name: Correctness
dimensions.description: Implements lookup, expiration, overwrite, eviction, and validation semantics.

dimensions.name: Data-structure selection
dimensions.description: Chooses and uses structures that match lookup and recency requirements.
strong_indicators: hash lookup and ordered recency are explicit
weak_indicators: linear recency search without acknowledging cost

dimensions.name: Testing
dimensions.description: Covers boundary time, overwrite, capacity, invalid TTL, and expired-length behavior.
evidence_required: candidate tests or stated test matrix

dimensions.name: Complexity and trade-offs
dimensions.description: Reports honest complexity and explains alternative expiration indexes.

dimensions.name: Production judgment
dimensions.description: Identifies concurrency, observability, stampede, and memory concerns.
strong_indicators: does not hold a global lock across an external loader
weak_indicators: equates a lock with a complete production design

score_bands.90-100: Correct, well-tested implementation with precise reasoning and mature production follow-ups.
score_bands.75-89: Correct core implementation with minor gaps in testing or production depth.
score_bands.60-74: Partially correct with material edge-case or complexity omissions.
score_bands.0-59: Incorrect cache invariants or insufficient evidence of required behavior.
